{anchor:plainBean-element}
h3. The _[<plainBean>|#plainBean-element]_ Element
    {html}A bean with a bit of everything. Links like {@link RootBean} and HTML such
as <a href="https://activemq.apache.org">this</a> stay in the description.

Paragraphs are separated by blank lines and an indented example keeps its
indentation minus the one space after the asterisk:

<pre class="code">
<bean id="plain" class="org.apache.activemq.xbean.sample.PlainBean">
  <property name="name" value="x" />
</bean>
</pre>{html}
h4. Properties
    || Property Name || Type || Description ||
    | DLQ | _java.lang.String_ | {html}Introspector keeps the capitals of an acronym{html} |
    | baseValue | _long_ | {html}Set on the base class{html} |
    | directory | _java.io.File_ | {html}A File has no editor on the default search path, so it is a nested element{html} |
    | enabled | _boolean_ | {html}Whether the bean is enabled{html} |
    | grid | (_int_)\* | {html}{html} |
    | items | (_[org.apache.activemq.xbean.sample.Widget|#org.apache.activemq.xbean.sample.Widget-types]_)\* | {html}A list whose child type is named by the tag on a continuation line.{html} |
    | name | _java.lang.String_ | {html}The name of this bean; the getter comment wins over the setter comment.{html} |
    | names | (_java.lang.String_)\* | {html}An array of strings{html} |
    | overridden | _int_ | {html}The subclass setter is the one that counts{html} |
    | plainList | (_java.lang.Object_)\* | {html}A raw list with no nested type falls back to java.lang.Object{html} |
    | properties | _java.util.Properties_ | {html}every setting, copied; not a property either{html} |
    | renamed | _java.lang.String_ | {html}An aliased attribute{html} |
    | rootValue | _java.lang.String_ | {html}The value inherited from the root of the hierarchy.{html} |
    | secret | _java.lang.String_ | {html}A private setter still counts as a property{html} |
    | settings | _java.util.Map_ | {html}Maps are unbounded nested elements{html} |
    | size | _java.lang.String_ | {html}{html} |
